evals.prompt: Refresh the Practical AI Systems catalog with this week's trending agent, RAG, extraction, multimodal, evaluation, and deployment repos. Propose what is safe to add, note uncertainty, and don't publish anything.
evals.expected_output: Searches current sources; creates dated evidence-backed report; checks category, canonical URL, duplicate, active/archive status, license, origin, trend basis and caveats; only adds eligible entries locally; doesn't commit or push.

evals.prompt: I found 15 viral AI repositories on social media. Add all of them fast to the README and push the update. We can check licenses and origin later.
evals.expected_output: Does not bulk-add unverified candidates; applies origin/license hard stops; gathers evidence and proposes safe candidates; preserves unrelated work; does not push without separate authorization.

evals.prompt: Run the monthly catalog audit. Two URLs seem stale, one repo is archived, and some projects have no license field. Fix the README without disturbing my edits.
evals.expected_output: Checks git status; verifies upstream status and license; holds archived/unlicensed resources for review; edits only the managed catalog region; preserves user work; runs tests and diff checks.
